We take serious exception to Foreign Minister’s April 17 statement
                                in Parliament in regard to Vietnam. We consider this officialGOIpolicy statement is most disturbing
                                indication of Indian attitude regarding matter of great interest to
                                USG.
Therefore Ambassador should seek urgent appointment with Foreign
                                Minister to discussGOIstatement.
                                Ambassador should say we consider this particularly unbalanced
                                comment on matter of very great interest to USG. We regard this
                                statement as a further unfriendly act on part of GOI. FonMin’s
                                statement is especially unfortunate in light of earlierUSGdemarche to Indian Ambassador in
                                Washington.
As further indication of seriousness with whichUSGviews Indian Vietnam policy, for
                                next two weeks Ambassador should hold to minimum his contacts with
                                Indian officials and maintain formal stance during such contacts.
                                For this period Ambassador should attend no social events hosted byGOIofficials.

                                indication of Indian attitude regarding matter of great interest to

2.
Therefore Ambassador should seek urgent appointment with Foreign
                                Minister to discuss
GOI
statement.

                                comment on matter of very great interest to USG. We regard this
                                statement as a further unfriendly act on part of GOI. FonMin’s
                                statement is especially unfortunate in light of earlier
USG
demarche to Indian Ambassador in
                                Washington.
3.
As further indication of seriousness with which
USG
views Indian Vietnam policy, for

officials.
